title: Five-fold scenario-group out-of-fold calibration
mechanism: Train the same lightweight model on five scenario-safe folds and select one threshold from pooled out-of-fold predictions.
expected_effect: Reduce threshold overfitting and produce confidence intervals for all reported metrics.
risk: Some folds may contain too few examples of a scene family.
success_criteria: No scenario leakage; pooled macro F1 >= 0.70; 95% bootstrap interval reported; all folds contain both labels.

title: Contrastive scenario-pair ranking and hard-negative curriculum
mechanism: For each matched scenario, require the positive video peak to exceed the negative peak by a margin and repeatedly sample verified false-positive windows.
expected_effect: Reduce the dominant error cluster: normal videos in matched pairs ranked above violations.
risk: Incorrect positive labels can invert the ranking objective; medium and low confidence pairs need review or reduced weight.
success_criteria: Nested OOF macro F1 +0.10, paired false positives below 5, and recall does not fall below 0.67.

title: Weakly supervised temporal MIL ranking
mechanism: Represent every complete video as a bag of snippets, rank anomalous snippets above normal snippets, and add temporal smoothness and sparsity losses.
expected_effect: Improve full-video ranking and temporal localization without assuming every positive-video frame is abnormal.
risk: Small data can make MIL select background shortcuts; scenario-safe folds remain mandatory.
success_criteria: OOF AUROC +0.05 or timestamp MAE -20% without macro F1 regression; stable top snippets on contrastive pairs.

title: Self-supervised pretraining on local unlabelled windows
mechanism: Pretrain a compact video encoder with masked reconstruction or contrastive objectives on all local footage, then fine-tune the anomaly head.
expected_effect: Learn this camera angle, furniture, hands, doors, and cash-desk motion without needing more labels.
risk: Full VideoMAE is too heavy for 4 GB VRAM; start with frozen features or a small encoder.
success_criteria: OOF AUROC +0.03 with <=2x inference latency and no external video upload.

title: Human-review active learning and embedding memory
mechanism: Store reviewed hard negatives, false negatives, embeddings, observable actions, and reviewer decisions; sample low-margin and novel clips for review.
expected_effect: Spend annotation time on clips that most reduce uncertainty and repeated errors.
risk: Reviewer inconsistency can amplify label noise; require dual fields for observation and interpretation.
success_criteria: Every cycle adds >=10 reviewed high-value clips and reduces repeated error clusters on the next OOF run.

title: Fuse video score with people, zone, door, and table-state signals
mechanism: Add interpretable trajectories and state changes as a small late-fusion feature vector rather than asking one classifier to infer every rule.
expected_effect: Reduce shortcuts and produce evidence aligned with observable rules such as zone crossing or unattended values.
risk: Object labels and zone polygons require verified annotation; object identity must not be guessed.
success_criteria: At least one rule-specific detector improves its contrastive-pair F1 by 0.10 and produces reviewable evidence.

title: Meta-learning across confirmed violation families
mechanism: Treat each confirmed rule family as a task and learn an initialization that adapts from few reviewed examples.
expected_effect: Faster adaptation when ForteBank adds a new confirmed rule or camera layout.
risk: Premature until at least three confirmed classes have enough reviewed examples.
success_criteria: At least three confirmed tasks; leave-one-family-out improvement over ordinary fine-tuning.
